import sys

def solve():
    mod = 1000000007
    input = sys.stdin.read()
    data = input.strip().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    dp = [[0]*(n+1) for _ in range(n+1)]
    dp[0][0] = 1
    for i in range(n+1):
        for j in range(i, n+1):
            if j != i:
                dp[i][j] += dp[i][j-1]
            if i != 0:
                dp[i][j] += dp[i-1][j]
            dp[i][j] %= mod
    ans = 0
    for j in range(n, -1, -1):
        for i in range(j-1, -1, -2):
            ans += dp[i][j]
            ans %= mod
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
